senses.definition: n.pr.m. (consecrated; cf. Sab. n.pr.m. חרם, יחרמאל Hal411. 504 DHMl.c.)—
priest of the third course, David’s time, according to 1 Ch 24:8.
priest of time of Nehemiah Ne 10:6.
heads of families of returning exiles:
Ezr 2:39 = Ne 7:42, Ezr 10:21 Ne 12:15.
Ezr 2:32 = Ne 7:35, Ezr 10:31 Ne 3:11.
